grammar.title: Caring about someone with 关心
grammar.explanation: 关心 (guānxīn) means "to care about, to be concerned about" used as a verb with an object (关心朋友), or as a state with 很 (很关心).

sentences.en: The teacher cares a lot about the students.

sentences.pinyin: Māma hěn guānxīn wǒ de shēntǐ.
sentences.en: Mom really cares about my health.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu hěn guānxīn zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.en: We all care a lot about this matter.
Thank you for caring about me.
